description.en: The synchronization or subscribe instance ID.
The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task.

description.zh: DTS实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the DTS instance. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
同步方向，取值：

- **Forward**：正向。
- **Reverse**：反向。

> - 默认取值为**Forward**。
- 当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入**Reverse**以重置反向同步链路。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to reset the reverse synchronization task only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

descriptions.zh: > 清空数据同步或订阅任务配置后，原先的任务就会被删除，DTS将重新创建一个未配置的任务，您需要调用接口[ConfigureDtsJob](~~208399~~)重新配置该任务。
descriptions.en: > After the configuration of a data synchronization or change tracking task is cleared, the original task is deleted. DTS creates a new unconfigured task. You must call the [ConfigureDtsJob](~~208399~~) operation to reconfigure the task.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts reset-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-aekzn4iqlbsm7hy --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ResetDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzn4iqlbsm7hy' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
